entries.name: xray-core
entries.notes: Merge stable upstream into the N2X fork before changing this exact replacement; retain ArtX, AnyTLS, per-listener fallback and TLS bridge compatibility. Retain the pinned REALITY compatibility copy and cross-client Vision/HTTPS regressions; an explicit zero version floor must permit authenticated X25519-only fingerprints.

entries.name: sing-box
entries.notes: Manual stable merge required before repinning. Preserve Scope lifecycle, dynamic users, AnyTLS cleanup, Naive browser proxy and per-node sniff/resolve. Compatibility copy origins are recorded in the fork.
